writeup.headline: Innodata rates Hold: strong growth and net cash offset by a broken share-price trend and customer worries.
writeup.thesis: Innodata scores 63, a Hold just 2 points below the Buy line, held up by its fundamentals and pulled down by its chart. Growth scores 91 on TTM revenue growth of 39.0% and latest-quarter revenue growth of 57.8% year on year, and growth sped up by 3.4 pp from the previous quarter. The balance sheet scores 100 with net cash and no debt. Quality scores 69, with a 42.7% gross margin, an 18.2% operating margin and diluted share count down 1.5% year on year. Valuation is middling at 53: P/S of 4.8x, normalised P/FCF of 22.9x and EV/EBIT of 22.4x are moderate-to-high in absolute terms, with FCF yield 0.6 pp below the 10-year Treasury yield, and P/S sits near the middle of the last 61 month-ends. Trend scores just 16, with the price 63.2% below its 52-week high and 27.4% below its 200-day average, while news is neutral at 51 as a Buy initiation offsets reports of layoffs tied to a customer wind-down.
key_risks: Unconfirmed reports of about 550 layoffs in India tied to a customer assignment wind-down could signal a lost or reduced contract at a highly concentrated customer base.
Q3 results on November 5 could challenge the 40%+ FY2026 revenue growth guidance.
Weak price trend: shares down 12.9% from 12 months ago to 1 month ago and 25.2% below the 50-day average.
Recent free cash flow was boosted by an unusual spike (reported FCF margin 58.0%), so normal cash generation is closer to the 21.2% normalised margin.
An older AI-washing class action remains pending.
what_would_change: A gain of 2 points would lift the rating to Buy, for example from a recovering price trend (trend scores 16) or clearer news on the customer situation.
Q3 results that confirm the 40%+ growth guidance and dispel the contract-loss reports could improve the news and trend scores.
A confirmed major customer loss or a guidance cut would hit growth and news scores, though a fall to Sell would need a drop of 19 points.
